author: azulolivart
quote: i could easily disappear from real world just to live in **** valley for months. you can tell this was made with great love by a huge harvest moon fan. as one myself, i can only be grateful this exists.

author: azulolivart
quote: compelling storyline, very well written, very well executed open world mechanics, great map design, awesome art and memorable and really hard bosses. this game is so perfect it shouldn't exist.

author: azulolivart
quote: 200h+ of gameplay. very entertaining and nice, with a good storyline, unforgettable characters and great gameplay. loves it, but… objectively speaking, the subsurface was basically empty, and there were barely any sky islands to explore with nothing really impressive waiting for me there. sometimes it felt like a really huge BOTW DLC.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

author: azulolivart
quote: i feel like it’s a nice game, but unfortunately not for me. i just couldn’t stand the characters. i hate them both equally lol. like, why are they so stupid and why are they acting like twelve yo kids?? grow up! i get that’s the point and that they eventually get character development… but come on, they didn’t have to be SO stupid and stubborn.

author: azulolivart
quote: one of the best and heartbreaking and beautiful written Zelda ever made. ganondorf here is simply the best of all. charismatic characters, you can even empathize with the villain. great music, great gameplay, good map though it feels a little empty. that little detail is what makes it almost a perfect game.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker

author: azulolivart
quote: people always say the soundtrack is the best part, which i’d agree, but i’ll have to add that every single character is sooo memorable and charismatic, and that is very hard to achieve.

author: azulolivart
quote: first 20 hours are very slow. characters don’t have much charisma and are easily forgettable, it’s very hard to emphasize with both of them. visuals are great, but still don’t match what was shown in the trailers, making me feel like I was lied to. physics are just the classical rockstar ones, which means that they are good, but nothing new or revolutionary like we were all expecting. awfully optimized, i wasn’t actively trying to find bugs but they found me anyway, which is unforgivable for a game that’s has been in development for 13 years. it doesn’t deserve the praise it’s getting. didn’t add anything new to the game industry (the world feels very alive but that’s not something that GTA did, but RDR2, so that’s a praise that RDR2 deserves, not GTA VI). storyline is overall boring, arguably the worst in GTA history. it’s not worth $80. also awful anti-consumer behavior for not making this a physical game as well. not recommended at all.

author: azulolivart
quote:
a game that did history. this right here is the definition of LEGENDARY.

it’s the most perfect game ever created.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998)

author: azulolivart
quote: nice gameplay, beautiful art style, great music and a perfectly written storyline
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
